Type of the numeric log level.

## Signature

```typescript
export type NumericLogLevel = number;
```

## Remarks

The numeric log level is used in log level comparisons; its values are in `Logger.numericLevels`<!-- -->. It is the type of the first argument of the `write()` method, which subclasses may override.
